text:
Priya: Thanks everyone — following up from today's all-hands Q&A. Dropping quick clarifications on promo timing, retro pay, and appeals. Post any edge cases and we'll loop in managers. :wave:
Zach: Do we have final dates for the promotion window and when retro pay kicks in?
Priya: Promo window opens Aug 15 and closes Sep 5. Managers need rubrics in by Sep 12. Retroactive comp for approved promos is effective Sep 1; payroll will reflect estimates mid-Sep. (cc @Marta)
Marta: Confirmed — calibration meetings are scheduled Sep 8–9. Managers, please upload evidence to the Promotions/Calibration folder: https://drive.company/promos (use the shared template).
Jenna: For IC->Lead transitions, will comp bands change or is it handled case-by-case?
Sam: Bands remain the canonical source, but we may shift ranges for some new role titles. People Ops will publish a short mapping doc next week explaining any deltas.
Jenna: Got it — where can I pull my team's feedback from the last cycle?
Priya: Feedback packets are in Lattice under Reviews > Previous cycle. If you can't access a packet, DM me and I'll grant view-only.
Oliver: What's the formal appeals process if someone disagrees with leveling?
Priya: Two-step: 1) Manager discussion within 7 days of notification. 2) If unresolved, submit an appeal to People Ops within 14 days — include evidence. We anonymize reviewer comments during calibration on request.
Zach: Any shifts to comp philosophy this year (market adjustments, weighting toward performance vs tenure)?
Sam: We're keeping target percentiles similar but increasing the overall budget to better match market data. Expect slightly higher uplift for top performers; details in the compensation FAQ soon.
Marta: Also a reminder — managers must complete the 30-min calibration training before Sep 7. RSVP here: https://calendar.company/calibration-training
PeopleOps-Bot: Reminder: calibration training session tomorrow 10:00 AM — registered: 48.
Priya: Thanks for the questions. We'll synthesize an FAQ and send a one-pager by EOD; tagging managers to read before calibration. :memo:
